Mr. K.K. Gaya, Asc
 Mr. K. Nayak, Advocate
 (For O.P. No.2)
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the Informant.

2. Being aggrieved by the order dated 31.01.2020 passed by the learned Special Judge, Karanjia in Special G.R. Case No.34/24 of 2018/2019 issuing NBW(A) against the Petitioner for violation of the condition imposed, this CRLMC is filed u/S-482 of Cr.P.C.
3.

The offence alleged against the Petitioner is under Section- 376/506 of IPC, r/w Section-3(1)(r)
and (s) and Section 3(2)(v) of S.C. & S.T.(P.A.) Act, 1989.

4. It is apt to note here that the learned Court in seisin while granting bail to the Petitioner, inter alia, imposed the following conditions xxx xxx xxx "he shall appear before the Investigating Officer once in a week on the day and time fixed by the said Investigating Officer till submission of F.F. and thereafter before this Court on each adjourned date till the case is concluded."
xxx xxx xxx
5. For alleged violation of the said condition NBW(A) was issued.

sentences.text: It is apt to note here that alleging the imposition of the said condition the Petitioner approached this Court in CRLMA No.412 of 2019.
And by order dated 18.12.2019 the said condition was substituted as under.

" the Petitioner shall appear before the investigating Officer as and when so required till submission of F.F. and he shall appear in person on the date fixed before the Court in seisin of the case till conclusion of the trial, except under some exceptional circumstances to the satisfaction of the said Court."
7.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that evidently the order passed by this Court was not brought to the notice of the learned Court in seisin while issuing NBW(A).
Hence, he submits that the impugned order may be set aside and the Petitioner may be allowed to appear to release on bail as before.

8. Learned counsel for the State and informant oppose the contention of the learned counsel for the Petitioner in as much as it is stated that the Petitioner has deliberately violated the order passed.
He did not even the appear once before the Court.
Hence no leniency ought to be shown to him.

9. It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the informant that the Petitioner has even violated the order passed by this Court as admittedly charge sheet was submitted and cognizance was taken on 18.04.2020.

10. It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that since the Petitioner is working as a sepoy of Orissa Special Armed Police, 1st S.S. Battalion, Samablpur, the non- appearance on the date fixed was not willful and therefore raise for lenient view to be taken.

11. On a conceptus materials on record keeping in view the order passed by this Court dated 18.12.2019 in CRLMA No.412 of 2019 referred to hereinabove modifying the earlier condition which has patently not being taken into account and the accused was released on bail on 28.06.2018, this Court is persuaded to set aside the impugned order dated 31.01.2020 passed by the learned Special Judge, Karanjia in Special G.R. Case No.34/24 of 2018/19 issuing NBW(A).
12.

It is further directed that the Petitioner shall surrender within a period of 4 weeks hence and shall be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin to ensure his presence on each effective date.
While fixing such terms the peculiar nature of the Petitioner's professional occupation, shall be taken into account.
13. For a period of 4 weeks from today no coercive action shall be taken against the Petitioner.
14. Taking into account that the matter is of the year 2018, learned Court in seisin is requested to conclude the trial expeditiously.
15. Accordingly, the CRLMC stands disposed of.
